character: Family-friendly mid-station built around a frozen lake (Lac de la Girose). Sunny all day. Ski-in/ski-out. Large outdoor ice rink on the lake. Portetta bar has the largest terrace in Courchevel. Ecorce concept store + restaurant.
dining: Le Portetta (large terrace, pizza, live music). L'Ecorce (concept store + restaurant). Fire & Ice. La Bokka (trattoria). Club de la Girose.
shopping: Ecorce concept store. Ski rental shops. Small supermarket. Boutique shops.
apres_scene: Le Portetta (largest terrace, log fires, heated seating), Fire & Ice, La Taïga (cocktail bar).
activities_nearby: Lac de la Girose ice skating (natural frozen lake). Aquamotion aquatic centre (shared with 1850). Snowshoeing, sledging. 4-min gondola to 1850.
